title: Why Isn't Pluto a Planet Anymore? | Space Atlas
description: Pluto didn't change — the definition of "planet" did. See the exact rule that reclassified Pluto as a dwarf planet in 2006.
ogTitle: Why Isn't Pluto a Planet Anymore?
ogDescription: The exact three-part IAU rule that reclassified Pluto in 2006 — and why it's about clearing an orbit, not about size.
jsonldName: Why Isn't Pluto a Planet Anymore?
jsonldDescription: An explanation of the 2006 IAU planet definition and why Pluto is classified as a dwarf planet rather than a planet.
